messages:
Megan Li: Quick preflight — we have the 09:00 Serving at Scale session. Final checklist for greenroom, recording, and lead routing.
Sam Patel: copy. recording strategy? cloud only or backup local?
Megan Li: Cloud record + local backup on lead presenter's laptop. Ask them to upload raw files to GDrive within 1 hour post-event. Also request separate audio files for each panelist.
Noah Kim: Updated Zoom settings in the meeting config: 
```
- Record to cloud: enabled
- Record active speaker and gallery: enabled
- Record separate audio files: enabled
- Original sound for presenters: enabled
- Auto-transcribe: disabled (we're using external captioning)
```
Tara O'Neill: @Sam please confirm RTMP fallback details for streaming to YouTube in case Zoom streaming fails.
Sam Patel: RTMP fallback yes. Credentials saved in 1Password under marketing/webinars/serve-scale. Shared with on-call via a read-only link.
Megan Li: Greenroom run-of-show (abridged):
1) 08:30 — Greenroom opens, tech check, mics/original sound verify
2) 08:45 — Slides upload, screen-share test, spotlight host
3) 09:00 — Go live to registrants, timer started
4) 09:20 — Panel segment begins (3 speakers), moderator to field queued questions
5) 09:45 — Live Q&A (10 minutes)
6) 09:55 — Wrap, CTAs, next steps
Noah Kim: Host notes + cue sheet: https://go.redwood.ai/host-notes (includes 30/60/90s cue markers and slide numbers).
Javier Ruiz: Naming convention for files so editors can find things?
Megan Li: Use: Redwood_ServingAtScale_YYYYMMDD_panel.mp4 and an accompanying Redwood_ServingAtScale_YYYYMMDD_panel_audio_{speaker}.wav for separate tracks. Put raw assets in /Marketing/Events/ServingAtScale/raw.
Sam Patel: Post-event owner matrix:
- Raw file upload: Presenter -> GDrive (then Sam copies to S3)
- 2-min highlight edit: Marketing (Tara)
- Full recording + SRT/captions: Partner Ops (Noah)
- Registrant replay email + CTA: Growth (Megan)
Tara O'Neill: Lead routing: tag form submissions with "event:serving_at_scale" and add hidden field "source:webinar". If attendee selects "interested in demo" then add tag "demo_request".
Megan Li: Zap flow outline: 
```
Zoom registrant -> Marketo form -> HubSpot contact -> add tag event:serving_at_scale -> if demo_request true -> route to SDR queue
```
Noah Kim: Add attended flag on contact: "attended:yes" or "attended:no" based on Zoom attendee CSV. We'll attach the attendance CSV and the cloud transcript to the HubSpot timeline.
Sam Patel: Confirmed — Zap will attach the attendance CSV and the cloud recording link to the contact record. Ran a test yesterday, works for sample payloads.
Megan Li: Post-event timing SLA: 
- 0–4 hours: raw files uploaded, Slack announcement in #marketing with ETA for edit
- 24 hours: registrant replay email (2-min highlight + full recording link)
- 48 hours: lead triage complete, demo requests queued in SDR board
- 72 hours: social highlight posted and initial performance check
Javier Ruiz: Accessibility: make sure SRT + captions are delivered with the edit ticket. Editors need SRT and the separate audio for accurate caption QC.
Tara O'Neill: I'll prep social copy drafts and drop into the marketing channel after we confirm final timecode for the highlight.
DeployBot: Recording started (2419990101)
Sam Patel: Contingency plan — if a panelist drops or has poor audio, switch them to phone dial-in, record slide audio locally, and note timestamps to stitch in edit.
Megan Li: Final EOD checklist: 
- [ ] Presenters confirmed they have original sound on
- [ ] RTMP creds in 1Password confirmed
- [ ] Editor on-call confirmed (Javier)
- [ ] Zap + HubSpot tags tested (Sam)
- [ ] Caption vendor briefed (Noah)
Noah Kim: I'll run a dress rehearsal tomorrow 09:00 in the greenroom link and share recording settings screenshots.
Megan Li: thanks everyone :rocket: keep updates in the host-notes doc and ping if anything changes.
